2019 SCORING COMMENTARY 

Question 4 

Note: Student samples are quoted verbatim and may contain spelling and grammatical errors. 

Overview 

The context for this problem is a cylindrical barrel with a diameter of 2 feet that contains collected rainwater, some 
of which drains out through a valve in the bottom of the barrel. The rate of change of the height h of the water in the 

barrel with respect to time t is modeled by dh
